_doc: The upstream Telosmith (formerly AEC) kit this repo's .aec/ records follow (D-0021). It is not vendored: CI installs this commit and runs its CLI. .github/workflows/aec-upstream.yml (D-0022) checks upstream weekly and opens a PR that moves this pin when MtG's records still pass; merging it is the decision. By hand: python3 tools/aec_sync.py --test --write.
